description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the StreamTrigger class, verifying its immutability, equality, rescheduling behavior, and trigger calculation logic based on different timing scenarios.

classes.name: StreamTriggerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the StreamTrigger class, contains multiple test methods to verify its behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the StreamTrigger class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the StreamTrigger class correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: reschedule
methods.description: Tests the rescheduling functionality of StreamTrigger, ensuring correct behaviour when shifting the trigger time.

methods.name: calculateTriggerWithLastEndLongTimeInThePast
methods.description: Checks trigger calculation when last end time is well in the past.

methods.name: calculateTriggerWithLastEndInThePastInsideStartOffset
methods.description: Checks trigger calculation when last end time is in the past but within the start offset window.

methods.name: calculateTriggerWithLastEndEqualToNow
methods.description: Checks trigger calculation when last end equals current time.

methods.name: calculateTriggerWithLastEndLongTimeInTheFuture
methods.description: Checks trigger calculation when last end time is far in the future.

methods.name: calculateTriggerWithLastEndInTheFutureInsideStartOffset
methods.description: Checks trigger calculation when last end time is in the future but within the start offset window.
